notes: Strip b: x 2260-3960 plus overlap 1960-4260. Montgomery Road printed 'ROAD' in this strip and 'MONTGOMERY' at the bottom-left of the plate; centre taken between the lot lines (yellow band on the west side and the grey band/tracks inside the road). Lafayette Avenue ('LAFAYETTE', 'AVE.' at x~4380 y~130) is the street along the SE side of the B&O tracks; the tracks themselves are not picked. Madison and Monroe print no suffix in this strip. Williams Avenue east of Montgomery Road carries no name in this strip; it is the continuation of 'WILLIAMS' west of the road (and 'WILLIAMS ... AVENUE' further east). The long N-S street at x~3490-3530 is printed only 'AVENUE' between Cameron and Williams and 'ELSMERE' south of Williams; the short street Ashland-Cameron at x~3757 is printed 'ELSMERE AVE.' - both recorded as Elsmere Avenue. Cleneay east of Regent prints only 'AVENUE'. Grey, pink, blue and green bands are boundaries. Plate is slightly skewed: N-S streets drift ~+1 px east per 100 px south.
